preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and the minimum of the number of possible edges in a complete graph and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the weight of the minimum spanning tree, which is the minimum of m and n-1.
